summary.headline: Axiscades Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 42% YoY to ₹346 crore, but reported PAT loss of ₹14.8 crore; normalized PAT ₹20.2 crore.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 was the first quarter of the divestment-led transition: Engineering Services is shown as discontinued operations (₹163 crore revenue), leaving continuing operations at ₹183 crore, up 94% YoY. Reported EBITDA for the combined business was ₹27.9 crore, with one-offs of ₹13.1 crore (including ₹9.62 crore receivable provision on an aged defence transaction and ₹3.5 crore hedge provision) and ₹21.81 crore divestment transaction cost below EBITDA. Management says normalized EBITDA was ₹41 crore (11.8% margin) and normalized PAT ₹20.2 crore. Guidance was reaffirmed: FY27 continuing revenue of ₹1,377 crore, EBITDA of ₹270 crore and PAT of about 50% of that, with acquisitions and divestment proceeds central to delivery.

segments.name: Defence (continuing)
segments.commentary: Record ₹125 crore revenue, up 112% YoY, with underlying EBITDA of ₹13 crore (up 15% YoY). Reported EBITDA ₹2.6 crore after ~₹9.6 crore one-time costs; management cites underlying 9.7% margin. Assured forecast visibility ₹4,557 crore after 8 wins since April.

segments.name: XiDA (ex-ESAI, US-headquartered)
segments.commentary: Revenue ₹49.5 crore, up 63% YoY, at ~33% EBITDA margin (EBITDA ₹14.7 crore cited, ~30% in another remark). Added two large global technology customers via a business transfer.

segments.name: Aerospace manufacturing
segments.commentary: Revenue ₹6.1 crore in Q1 with negative EBITDA; 30-member leadership team built ahead of acquisitions.

segments.name: Mistral
segments.commentary: Delivered ₹122 crore revenue at ~14.5% EBITDA margin while absorbing its own provisions.

segments.name: ADD Solutions (non-core, European)
segments.commentary: EBITDA loss ₹4.8 crore and PAT loss ₹6.7 crore; exit targeted by Q4 FY27 with a sale process that could realize over FY27.

guidance_outlook: FY27 continuing operations revenue guidance reaffirmed at ₹1,377 crore on an annualized pro forma basis.
FY27 EBITDA target of ₹270 crore; PAT expected at roughly 50% of EBITDA (~₹135 crore), could be higher with lower interest after debt paydown.
Defence revenue expected to grow over 75% YoY in FY27 and over the following years; ESAI/XiDA expected to grow over 100% this year.
Aerospace manufacturing target: annualized run rate of ₹375 crore revenue and ₹84 crore EBITDA by Q4 FY27, with the platform aiming at ~₹1,000 crore by FY29.
Power 930 targets (FY30 PAT of ₹960 crore) stated as unchanged.
Deferred ~₹140-142 crore revenue: ~40% (over ₹60 crore) recovered in Q1; balance planned across Q2 and Q3.
capex_capacity: Akkodis divestment valued at US$237 million (~₹2,256 crore); Phase 1 targeted by Aug 31 with ~₹190 crore post-tax cash; Phase 2 by Nov 30 (management later said it is trying to pull it to about September) bringing ~₹525 crore cash.
Extraordinary gain of ~₹1,255 crore to be recognised on closing; ~₹200+ crore expected in Q2, the bulk in Q3 (or late Q2).
Aerospace services divestment expected to close in Q2 FY27; combined divestment proceeds ~₹920 crore cited.

Devanahalli AeroLand Complex (DAL) commissioned; Devanahalli Atmanirbhar Complex (DAC) construction ongoing on 20 acres; Missile Atmanirbhar Complex in Hyderabad groundbreaking early July, construction begun; Center for Advanced Manufacturing (240,000 sq ft, 20 acres) being planned.
PP&E rose ₹40 crore in one quarter for Power 930 ramp-up. CapEx to be matched to inflows, with a short-term bridge facility; actual drawdown not more than ₹100-150 crore.
demand_pricing: Defence assured forecast visibility rose to ₹4,557 crore after ~₹332 crore of new wins; management says it converts over ~3 years to FY30. Total pipeline cited at ~₹24,000 crore.

Wins include BrahMos and anti-tank missile onboard electronics (development-cum-production), helicopter ERP, Uttam radar antenna beam control, and a 30 kW laser directed energy weapon technology transfer.
LUH Maritime order visibility of ₹150-170 crore this year, stated as backed by confirmed orders.
MBDA test bench programme: about 5 test benches per year for 3 years; launcher maintenance expanding with a Rafale-linked order.
Aerospace: non-binding offer signed for an AS9100 precision manufacturer; FY27 revenue ~₹180 crore and EBITDA ~₹39 crore (22% margin) annualized, due diligence to complete in Q2.
BrahMos NG seeker: prototype in advanced stage; seeker business expected from next financial year (FY28).
